facts.fact: A peer-reviewed feasibility study by Josiline Chigwada (Chinhoyi University of Technology) finds from web content analysis that Zimbabwe has no open data policy in place and is not an Open Government Partnership member, and recommends that a national policy be crafted and enacted; the document gives no finding date, so the 2022-08-12 publication date is used.
